description: This script automates the creation of Liquibase schema and data snapshots for an OpenMRS project. It provides functions to build the necessary Maven project, delete old snapshot files, generate new changelogs, and display usage instructions. The script is intended to be run within the openmrs-core/liquibase directory to facilitate database versioning and migration processes.

methods.name: build_openmrs_liquibase
methods.description: Builds the OpenMRS Liquibase-related components using Maven.

methods.name: delete_snapshots
methods.description: Deletes existing Liquibase snapshot files from the snapshots directory.

methods.name: create_snapshots
methods.description: Generates new Liquibase changelog files for schema and data snapshots, parameterized by username and password.

methods.name: echo_usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.
